summary: Full backend (pytest, 19/19 passed) + frontend (Playwright) E2E testing of grau TI Helpdesk. All requested features verified: public ticket submission (validation + GT-XXXXXX code toast), device status toggles, priority select, talk_to_deivid, notes, public status lookup (valid + invalid), public Deivid streaming chat, admin login (both users), unauth redirect, wrong-password error, KPIs, ticket list, filters, search, inline status change, audit trail dialog, archive/unarchive with archived view toggle (no delete), and admin Deivid streaming with real ticket context. Everything works.

issues: Console a11y warnings: `DialogContent`/`SheetContent` missing `DialogTitle`/aria-describedby (Radix warns). Non-blocking but should be fixed for accessibility.

action_items: (Optional/low priority) Add `DialogTitle` (or VisuallyHidden title) and `DialogDescription`/aria-describedby to the Deivid Sheet and any DialogContent that logs Radix accessibility warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: /api/tickets create/update return the full doc via serialize_ticket — good, `_id` is properly converted to `id` string.
Backend: seed_admins is idempotent and rehashes if password in env changes — correct.
Backend: JWT_SECRET, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY read via os.environ[..] (fail-fast) — good.
Backend: /api/chat is unauthenticated for both scopes — acceptable per spec (Deivid is public-facing too), but if quota abuse becomes a concern consider rate limiting.
Frontend AdminPage.jsx (~410 lines) is close to the 700-line soft limit; acceptable for now but consider splitting Filters/TicketRow/AuditDialog into subcomponents as it grows.

AdminPage renders multiple `data-testid="admin-status-dropdown"`/`admin-btn-archive-ticket`/`admin-btn-audit-trail` (one per row). This is fine for scans but tests must select by row context to avoid ambiguity.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env). All 19 tests pass. Frontend has data-testid on every interactive element. Public Deivid chat input testid is `deivid-chat-input`. Admin status dropdown / archive / audit-trail buttons repeat per row — index them. Note: pytest is configured with pytest-xdist and rootdir=/app/backend; run from /app so relative paths resolve.
rca of the issue: No functional issues found. Only minor Radix a11y console warnings (missing DialogTitle/aria-describedby) on the Deivid Sheet and audit dialog — cosmetic, non-blocking. Mitigation: add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle and DialogDescription per Radix docs.
